name: chronicle
description: Per-project persistent memory for any Claude agent.

capture_profile.title: Capture Profile
capture_profile.description: How much the plugin captures automatically. One of: minimal, balanced, aggressive. 'minimal' = only explicit saves; 'balanced' = significant events + explicit; 'aggressive' = all tool use.

significance_mode.title: Significance Mode
significance_mode.description: Which events are considered significant enough to record. One of: auto, hybrid, explicit-only. 'auto' = plugin decides; 'hybrid' = auto + explicit; 'explicit-only' = only manual saves.

auto_write_on_stop.title: Auto Write on Stop
auto_write_on_stop.description: Automatically write a session summary note when the session ends.

lesson_on_failure.title: Lesson on Failure
lesson_on_failure.description: Record a lesson-candidate note whenever a Bash tool use fails.

surface_due_on_start.title: Surface Due on Start
surface_due_on_start.description: Surface notes with upcoming due dates at the start of each session.

max_notes_before_prune.title: Max Notes Before Prune
max_notes_before_prune.description: Warn when the vault exceeds this many notes. Set to 0 to disable. Run 'chronicle-write archive' to prune old session notes.
